sentences.text: The temperature in the parents' room dropped to 17.9 °C at 00:00. Since WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons, this is something to note.
In the ironing room, the humidity was observed at 46.2 % from 03:00 to 06:00, which was below the expected range of 49.0 % to 51.2 %.
Given the temperature reading in the parents' room, perhaps checking the heating would be a gentle idea.
